propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded; it must become config-driven via S1 mapping_config to support per-project remaps and collapse operations.
Outbound mapping should resolve per-project via effective_status_map(project_key), merging builtin ← default ← projects.<KEY>, and thread the resolved status_map through CREATE and UPDATE mutations.
Unmapped local statuses must drift (omit status field in Jira, leaving it unchanged) with a deduped per-status alert, never coerce or fail.

Round-trip recovery must use a generalized rebar-status:<local> label rule that stamps whenever config.jira_to_local_status.get(target) != local, enabling lossless inbound recovery without a reverse map.
Fetcher and preflight validation must accept config-declared Jira status names (from mapping_config.declared_status_names) in addition to built-in names.
Inbound rebar-status:<local> parsing must use a shared derived vocabulary helper (not duplicate literals) covering all local status values the stamp rule can emit.
